Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In Step 10, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results from People.com (which confirmed Amy Poehler as the ex-wife from 2003-2016) and the existence of a relationship with Alessandra Brawn since 2019. The Planner erroneously concluded that Alessandra Brawn is the "spouse" and that the actor is currently married to her. The search results explicitly stated they were married until 2016 and did not mention a remarriage or a current legal marriage to Alessandra Brawn, only a "relationship" or "dating" status. By failing to distinguish between a legal spouse (ex-wife) and a current partner (girlfriend), the Planner generated a factually incorrect final answer claiming Alessandra Brawn is the spouse.
